refusals.message: a match that can fall through
refusals.name: fall-through-missing-err
refusals.source:
warrant refusals v1
  error E = A | B | C
  op f(a: Bool) -> Result<(Bool,Bool),E>
  op g(a: Bool) -> Result<Bool,E>
  model m(r: Result<Bool,E>) -> Bool = match r with Ok(_) -> true
